vintage.unesco: World Heritage List after the 2026 session (1,273 properties)

rules.text: UNESCO World Heritage properties of the map's countries (World Heritage List, UNESCO): every natural and mixed property, the cultural properties inscribed from 1978 to 1996, and for each country still without one its earliest-inscribed property. A serial or transboundary property appears once, at its first listed component (by UNESCO reference number) on a State Party's land; properties outside the map (New Caledonia, Curaçao…) are left out. Ranked by year of inscription.
